- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the issue.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your phone line is currently suspended because you have an overdue bill of $65.00 from your January billing cycle. To restore your service, you need to pay this overdue bill.

I have just sent you a payment request for the overdue amount. Please check your payment requests and follow the instructions to complete the payment. Once the payment is made and confirmed, I can help you resume your phone service. Let me know once you have completed the payment or if you need any assistance with the process.

history.content: My device rebooted successfully, but I still have no signal and can't make calls or send messages.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no signal, let's troubleshoot your device further.

Could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- “No Signal” or a signal strength indicator (bars)
- Any other unusual icons

This information will help me determine the next steps to restore your service.
I checked my status bar and I see 'Excellent', '5G', 'Data Enabled', and 'Connected to Chestnut-5G'. What should I do next?

Thank you for the details. Since your status bar shows “Excellent” signal, “5G”, and “Data Enabled,” your phone is connected to the cellular network and mobile data is on. You are also connected to Wi-Fi (“Chestnut-5G”).

If you still cannot make calls or send messages despite having excellent signal, let’s try the following steps:

1. Try making a call with Wi-Fi turned off to see if the issue is related to Wi-Fi Calling.
2. If you receive any error messages when trying to call or text, please let me know what they say.
3. Confirm if you can use mobile data (e.g., browse the internet with Wi-Fi turned off).

Please try these steps and let me know the results, so I can assist you further.

Wi-Fi is now off and my phone is disconnected from any wireless network. After turning off Wi-Fi, I was able to make a call and browse the internet using mobile data. Everything seems to be working well now.

That’s great to hear! It looks like your service has been fully restored and your phone is working properly on the cellular network.

If you experience any further issues or have questions about your account or service, feel free to reach out. Thank you for your patience!
